title: 1.1 miles. 6 windows. $500,000 #Shorts
description:
The Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel: 1.1 miles long, 22 feet wide, 16 feet high, with six windows cut into the cliff, and about half a million dollars to build. Zion was no longer a dead end.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 3: The Impossible Tunnel): https://youtu.be/30zzYRt_Mgk
